<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public mixed $payload,
        public mixed $value,
        public mixed $dup,
        public ?array $listOf,
        public ?string $nullFirst,
        public ?string $allNull,
        public mixed $nestedAny,
        public ?string $plain,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            payload: $data['payload'],
            value: $data['value'],
            dup: $data['dup'],
            listOf: $data['listOf'],
            nullFirst: $data['nullFirst'],
            allNull: $data['allNull'],
            nestedAny: $data['nestedAny'],
            plain: $data['plain'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'payload' => $this->payload,
            'value' => $this->value,
            'dup' => $this->dup,
            'listOf' => $this->listOf,
            'nullFirst' => $this->nullFirst,
            'allNull' => $this->allNull,
            'nestedAny' => $this->nestedAny,
            'plain' => $this->plain,
        ];
    }
}
